main_text.head: In accuratissimam Chronologiam, ab eruditissimo Theologo ABRAHAMO BVCOLZERO editam, ante vltimam operi tanto manum impositam, mortuo.

p.i: Tempora dinumerans, indefessoque labore Orbes retexens temporum, Perplexa euoluens, & clara in luce reponens Altis tenebris obruta, Sicne opere in medio, nos, Bucolzere, relictos Surfum profectus deseris? At te parte operis liceat plus dicere laudis Iustaque adeptum gloria, Quam nimium multos, operis quae falsa peraeti Imago pridem decipit.

main_text.head: IN GVLIELMI SALVSTII Heptameron, Gallicum poema, æterna memoria dignum.

p.i: Hebdomas una, Deo verbum genitale loquute, Nascente mundo vt extitit: Sic repetens certo septena volumina gyro, Menses que & annos metiens, Æuum impertitur mundo, sese haec fatenti Hebdomade natum viuere.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so the endings of the title and verse lines are missing. Several words in the first title block are cut mid-word at the edge. The first letter of the verse is a large initial and is joined to its word. The mark "c" at the top right is a stray scan edge and is not transcribed. The bottom word "Huius" is also cut off at the edge.
